visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with black hair and glasses wearing a blue top holds three white product boxes toward the camera. In the foreground, a brown tabby cat is grooming a tortoiseshell cat on a white ledge. The background features a large window with bright natural light and green foliage outside. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of three product boxes for 'Cat Hairball Paste Stick' with different colored accent labels (tan, blue, orange). The boxes are held steadily against a neutral background. (3) The shot returns to the medium view where the woman explains the product. The tortoiseshell cat sits on the ledge while the woman gestures with her hand. (4) A hand holds an individual white product sachet close to the tortoiseshell cat's face. The cat licks the light-colored paste from the top of the open sachet. (5) The woman holds a different product box for a white cat with grey patches. The cat is seen licking the paste from a sachet held by the woman's fingers. (6) A third cat, the brown tabby, is shown licking from a sachet while the white cat stands nearby. The woman's hands are visible guiding the sachet. (7) A final close-up shows the tabby cat's face as it licks the paste. The lighting is bright and clear, highlighting the cat's whiskers and eyes. (8) The video concludes with the woman talking to the camera again, still holding the product boxes in front of the window setting.
